data.body: When `runs_on` selects a persistent self-hosted runner, the worker workflows retain fixed `/tmp` paths across jobs. A failed long-running checker can consume an earlier `rollover_ready=true` result, launch a replacement run, and retire the active state artifact; suite jobs can similarly upload stale reports after an early failure. Allocate state, result, report, and history files in a cleared, per-job directory under `$RUNNER_TEMP` (including the view/suite) before enabling custom runners.
